conversation.content: Start a semester plan with MATH 151, Calculus I, as a 4-credit class.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/courses", "value": [{"courseCode": "MATH 151", "courseTitle": "Calculus I", "creditHours": 4}]}]
Put Calculus I down as an A- for now.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/courses/0/letterGrade", "value": "A-"}]
Add ENGL 210, Technical Writing, as a 3-credit course.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/courses/-", "value": {"courseCode": "ENGL 210", "courseTitle": "Technical Writing", "creditHours": 3}}]
Mark Technical Writing with a B+.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/courses/1/letterGrade", "value": "B+"}]
Include CS 240, Data Structures, as a 4-credit class too.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/courses/-", "value": {"courseCode": "CS 240", "courseTitle": "Data Structures", "creditHours": 4}}]
Give Data Structures a B.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/courses/2/letterGrade", "value": "B"}]
Add PHYS 201, General Physics I, for 4 credits.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/courses/-", "value": {"courseCode": "PHYS 201", "courseTitle": "General Physics I", "creditHours": 4}}]
Record General Physics I as a C+.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/courses/3/letterGrade", "value": "C+"}]
Use the school’s grade scale for these marks: A is 4.0, A- is 3.7, and B+ is 3.3.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/gradePointScale", "value": {"A": 4.0, "A-": 3.7, "B+": 3.3}}]
Finish the scale we need here with B worth 3.0 and C+ worth 2.3.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/gradePointScale/B", "value": 3.0}, {"op": "add", "path": "/gradePointScale/C+", "value": 2.3}]
When you calculate the average, weight it by credits and round the result to two decimals.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/gpaCalculation", "value": {"weightingBasis": "creditHours", "roundingDecimalPlaces": 2}}]
Now attach the matching point values to the first three course grades.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/courses/0/gradePoints", "value": 3.7}, {"op": "add", "path": "/courses/1/gradePoints", "value": 3.3}, {"op": "add", "path": "/courses/2/gradePoints", "value": 3.0}]
Add the matching point value for General Physics I as well.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/courses/3/gradePoints", "value": 2.3}]
Set the standing cutoffs so 2.0 or higher is good standing, 3.5 or higher qualifies for the dean’s list, and below 2.0 means probation.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/standingThresholds", "value": {"goodStandingMinimumGpa": 2.0, "deansListMinimumGpa": 3.5, "probationBelowGpa": 2.0}}]
Go ahead and total the credits and grade points, then calculate the semester average from them.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/semesterSummary", "value": {"totalCreditHours": 15, "totalQualityPoints": 45.9, "gpa": 3.06}}]
Based on those cutoffs, note the student’s current standing outcomes.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/standingFlags", "value": {"isInGoodStanding": true, "isOnDeansList": false, "isOnAcademicProbation": false}}]
Add the student details: Maya Chen, ID S104582, majoring in Computer Science.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/student", "value": {"studentName": "Maya Chen", "studentId": "S104582", "program": "Computer Science"}}]
Label this plan for the Fall 2025 term at North Valley University.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/term", "value": {"termName": "Fall 2025", "institution": "North Valley University"}}]
Add Dr. Priya Raman as the advisor, with praman@nvu.edu and office Science Hall 214.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/advisor", "value": {"advisorName": "Dr. Priya Raman", "advisorEmail": "praman@nvu.edu", "advisorOffice": "Science Hall 214"}}]
Include that the schedule was approved on August 18, 2025, and that the student is registered full time.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/registration", "value": {"approvalDate": "2025-08-18", "status": "full-time"}}]
Add the basic logistics too: Main Campus, mostly in person, with a note that the science courses include labs.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/logistics", "value": {"campus": "Main Campus", "deliveryMode": "mostly in person", "planningNote": "science courses include labs"}}]
Also note that this follows the 2025 catalog.
[{"op": "add", "path": "/catalogYear", "value": 2025}]

edit_instruction: Change General Physics I to an A.
annotation_notes: General Physics I grade C+ -> A; gradePoints from the stated scale 2.3 -> 4.0. Quality points for that course 4*4.0=16.0; totalQualityPoints 45.9 -> 52.7; gpa = 52.7/15 = 3.51 (credit-weighted, 2 dp). Crossing 3.5 flips isOnDeansList false -> true; good standing and probation flags unchanged. totalCreditHours, other courses, scale, thresholds, and descriptive fields stay.
conversation_pattern: Center the artifact on a course list where each course has credit hours and a letter grade, with a stated letter-grade-to-grade-point scale from which each course's grade points derive, a GPA derives as the credit-weighted average of those grade points, and standing flags derive from the GPA against stated thresholds. Around this core, add the realistic, independent details a course plan would carry that do not depend on the grades, and vary their number and the number of courses from sample to sample.
edit_pattern: Change one course's letter grade to a specific new letter grade.
cascade_pattern: Editing a course's letter grade re-derives that course's grade points from the stated scale, then the GPA re-derives as the credit-weighted average, and the standing flags re-evaluate against the stated thresholds. Other grades and credits stay. This is determined because the grade scale and thresholds are stated.
